stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week vegan hypertrophy with movement quality" 
TYPE workout 
VISIBILITY public 

GOALS
  GOAL primary muscle_hypertrophy:
    name "Plant-based hypertrophy goal with 150g/day protein"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Upper Push" training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
          dynamic_shoulder_neutral 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120s
          dumbbell_overhead_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90s
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90s
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Lower Pull" training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
          hiphinge_activation 3m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 180s
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90s
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY "Upper Pull" training 60m "Phase 1 - Week 1":

          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          forearm_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
